title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
About the role

Acme builds tools for example.com customers. You will design and run the platform that every Acme team ships on, from build pipelines to the database layer.

What you bring

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience
  • Deep knowledge of Postgres & Kubernetes

This is a hybrid role with three days a week in our Laurel office.

The annual base salary range for this role is $180,000 – $220,000.

enrichment.summary: Run the platform every Acme team ships on.
